answer: Each AI agent registers at a network vertex that issues a signed oasis token tied to a unique hardware enclave; the token must be presented whenever the agent submits a transaction. Periodically a random jury of peers selects a garden of submissions for spot‑check audit, verifying the enclave proof and the token’s freshness; any mismatch triggers a revocation cascade that isolates the offending node. An attacker must acquire a full enclave and a fresh oasis token for every fake identity, driving the cost linearly with the number of Sybils.
